Container.Overview: Cloud/API-key-first AutoGPT Platform for Unraid. Enter one OpenRouter key for AutoPilot chat, memory extraction, and the default remote search route, plus one OpenAI key for Graphiti memory embeddings. AutoGPT runs on your Unraid server; the model providers, not AutoGPT, host the models. Credentials selected inside individual agent blocks remain separate. For models you operate, install AutoGPT Fully Local instead.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: AI agent agents LLM automation workflow no-code low-code chatbot copilot self-hosted OpenAI Anthropic GPT
Container.Requires: Use this template for hosted providers. OpenRouter supplies primary chat, Graphiti's LLM calls, and the default remote search route; OpenAI supplies Graphiti's default embeddings. Both API keys are required for the complete default experience. AutoGPT does not host these models. Experimental single-node distribution; not a high-availability deployment. Set Public URL to the exact browser origin, including the selected port. Enter the intended first account email. After signup, open the container's Console, run autogpt-admin promote your-email@example.com, then set Allow New Accounts to false. Unraid masks key fields in the form, but host administrators can inspect stored container environment values. AutoGPT has used approximately 5-6 GiB of memory; leave additional headroom. For models you operate on this server or another trusted device, install AutoGPT Fully Local instead. Support: https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/autogpt-unraid/issues

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the AutoGPT web interface; the container port remains 3000. Example: 3000.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent accounts, agents, databases, memory, workspaces, and generated secrets. Example: /mnt/user/appdata/autogpt.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Exact browser origin, including the selected port. Example: http://192.168.1.10:3000. If this differs from the HTTP server-IP WebUI shortcut, open this URL directly.

Config.Name: First Account Email
Config.Description: Exact email address allowed to create the initial account. Example: you@example.com.

Config.Name: Allow New Accounts
Config.Description: Use true for first setup, then false after creating and promoting the intended account. Example: true.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: Key for primary AutoPilot chat, Graphiti memory extraction and reranking, and the default remote search route. Example format: sk-or-v1-...

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: Key for Graphiti's default memory embeddings. This is separate from the OpenRouter key and is required for complete memory support. Example format: sk-proj-...

Config.Name: Use Local Model Transport
Config.Description: Hosted profile selector; leave false. Use the AutoGPT Fully Local app for a model endpoint you operate. Example: false.

Config.Name: Use OpenRouter
Config.Description: Hosted profile selector; leave true so the OpenRouter key powers primary chat. Example: true.
